summary: Post-market, 2026-10-12. The composite reads 54.69 in the caution band inside an unchanged goldilocks regime, with trend_1d at 4.2 and a model confidence of 0.8976. The layer was generated at 19:37:35Z, about 22 minutes before the US cash close, so its equity readings are pre-close snapshots rather than settled closes. The day was a broad de-rating of the AI and high-beta complex rather than a macro shock: all 22 tracked sectors and themes closed lower, led by networking at -4.8602, memory at -4.2822, quantum_computing at -3.7728 and semiconductor_equipment at -3.3705, while the least damaged in the same complex were industrial_automation at -0.1136, gaming at -0.1249 and digital_advertising at -0.1836. US large-cap AI names followed: MU at -3.6975, AMD at -2.7273, AVGO at -1.8048, NVDA at -1.1645 and TSLA at -1.1197, and the week-to-date damage is heavier, with MU at -6.8619 and NVDA at -5.1444. Index-level damage was far smaller than theme-level damage, so this was a narrow high-multiple drawdown rather than a broad index break. Macro remains the binding constraint at a macro dimension score of 72.59, but the available rates vintage is 2026-10-08 and it eased: the 10Y nominal yield at 5.22 against 5.28 previously, the 10Y real rate at 2.87 against 2.92 previously and the 2Y at 4.75 against 4.77 previously. Credit split, with HY OAS at 3.15 against 3.09 previously while IG OAS held at 0.82, and volatility eased on the 2026-10-09 vintage with the VIX at 14.84 against 15.41 previously. Cross-asset confirmation at 0.625, which is 5 of the 8 production signals, contributes 9.375 as the largest single contribution and is the mechanical reason the composite rose. Two data-layer caveats shape how this layer should be read. First, the dollar input is frozen at the 2026-10-02 vintage at 121.3848. Second, the A-share leg did not roll: its prices reconcile exactly to the 2026-10-09 settled session, so this layer carries no 2026-10-12 mainland session.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the AI-complex de-rating broadens into equity structure
points: New lows at 0.1282 against new highs at 0.0256 on a 156-name basis, which is 20 against 4, is the classic broadening pattern.

Small-cap underperformance at -9.1233 and semis relative performance at -7.3144 show the drawdown is already concentrated outside the index leaders, so a further leg lower needs no new macro catalyst.
